source: NikVetr/shape_rotation (branch hardening, exporter commit fb04568): scripts/export_web_plan.R --frames-out on the default plans (seed 1), trimmed by the site's tmp/scripts/build_fixture.mjs
notes: Steps are R integration steps (1-based). xyz: projected x, y and depth of every vertex, rounded to 1e-9. drawOrder: 1-based face rows in the order R fills them, zero-area faces left out. visible: R face_label_visibility as hex, 4 faces per digit, high bit first. numbers: the face-number plan at the step, one digit per face.
